images.title: 324 splits into two equal groups
images.purpose: Shows the prime factors of 324 split into two identical groups, 2 × 3 × 3 and 2 × 3 × 3, so 324 = 18 × 18.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. The number at the top, two identical rows of prime tiles in the middle, and one equation below.
images.exact_structure: At the top centre: 324 in large dark digits. Below it, two identical horizontal rows of round tiles. Top row: exactly 3 tiles reading 2, 3, 3, filled teal (#0072B2). Bottom row: exactly 3 tiles reading 2, 3, 3, filled amber (#E69F00), each tile directly under its matching tile. Six tiles in all. Below the rows, centred: 18 × 18. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: A number is a perfect square when its prime factors split into two identical groups.
